name: Security Checklist
description: Run code through a standardised application-security checklist
content:
Perform a security review of the following code with threat model = {{threat_model}}.

{{code}}

Check for:
1. Injection (SQL, command, LDAP, template).
2. Authentication / session handling.
3. Authorization / access control.
4. Sensitive data exposure (secrets, PII, logs).
5. SSRF, XXE, and unsafe deserialization.
6. Insecure defaults and misconfigurations.

For each finding: severity (Critical / High / Medium / Low), line reference, exploitation sketch, and a minimal fix.

variables.name: code
variables.description: Snippet, file, or diff to review
